title: ProjectE fanout_plan — one record per candidate work unit

metric_name.$comment: Pinned against the C2-class name collision: parallelism_coverage is a trace-geometry metric owned by highspeed-routing. See _shared/glossary.md section 8.

signoff.$comment: An execution gate never produces a design PASS. It only decides whether work may be split.

run_id.$comment: Names runs/<run_id>/ - the publish pattern is owned by gptpro section 6, not redefined here.

domain_state.$comment: Aggregate over units. Subject to its own dictionary, NOT the closed verdict dictionary; it opens no gate on its own.

speedup_measured_s.$comment: null is the honest default. An unmeasured wall-clock claim is not evidence; leave it null rather than estimating.

writes.$comment: Repo-relative paths this unit will write. An absent or empty list makes the unit EXCLUDED - it cannot be proven disjoint.

failed_test.$comment: 1 independence, 2 writer-disjointness, 3 profitability, 4 execution envelope. null when every test passed.

touches_board.$comment: true when writes[] contains .kicad_pcb or .kicad_sch. Forces FANOUT_UNSAFE and defers to board-write-lock.

profitability.$comment: The four questions of SKILL section 2c. Rule: (bulky_output OR context_not_loaded) AND (summarisable AND own_deliverable). Anything else is INLINE_CHEAPER. There is no numeric threshold because no measured one exists - see references/execution-envelope.md section 3.

own_report_path.$comment: The --json report this branch writes. Required in practice: a failing run's stdout arrives truncated with no file path.

method.$comment: not_run is only legal when every unit is EXCLUDED, and then coverage.scanned is 0 -> NO_COVERAGE.

intersections.$comment: Every non-empty intersection is one coverage violation.

coverage.$comment: scanned + excluded == eligible; violations <= scanned; scanned == 0 -> NO_COVERAGE. Owner: _shared/coverage-gate.md.
